summary: Energy Services of America filed an 8-K announcing an Asset Purchase Agreement with FAMCO, Inc., a West Virginia water and sewer utility contractor. Its new subsidiary, FAMCO Acquisition, Inc., will buy substantially all operating assets for a $6.95M base price. At closing, three-eighths is cash, one-half is ESOA common stock issued soon after closing, and one-eighth is withheld for a post-closing true-up. Closing is anticipated on or about October 9, 2026, subject to conditions. No board recommendation, advisor, break fee, or regulatory clock disclosed; watch closing mechanics and earn-out adjustments.
